summary.name: Magic Hour
summary.one_liner: Magic Hour is a web-based AI studio for generating and editing videos and images, offering face swap, lip sync, talking photos, and a REST API with SDKs.
use_cases: Create short AI videos from a text prompt
Animate a still image into a video clip
Swap faces in photos or videos
Sync lips or make talking photos
Produce campaign assets at scale for teams
Build personalized image or video workflows through an API
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a platform for AI video generation, image generation, and image/video editing in one studio. Supported workflows include text-to-video, image-to-video, lip sync, talking photos, and face swap, with 25,000+ templates. Core tools can be tried free without sign-up, and outputs can be downloaded as images, clips, GIFs, or audio depending on the tool. A REST API and SDKs for Python, Node, Go, and Rust are offered for developers building repeatable image and video workflows.
notable: Core tools free to try without sign-up or credit card
Credit packs without a subscription; unused credits never expire
Web tools, REST API and SDKs share one credit balance
caveats: Free video and audio outputs may include a watermark; paid plans and credit packs remove watermarks where applicable
Higher resolutions, faster queues, and paid models require paid plans or credits
Commercial use of outputs requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or paid usage arrangement; free outputs are limited to personal non-commercial use
